focus: Capability/generalization/reliability of actual QNN circuits; speed is not the main objective.

review_by_cycle.finding: Multiple measured outputs improve breadth without deeper gates: radial~98%,linear~96%,but mixed frequency~55%.
review_by_cycle.next: Add several fixed encoding scales and matched-count controls.

review_by_cycle.finding: Frequency bank learns mixed-frequency~94%,but cosine drops~89%; more features can overfit or dilute inductive bias.
review_by_cycle.next: Charge measurement settings and test finite shots.

review_by_cycle.finding: Joint-outcome measurement at finite total budget reduces accuracy. Correlations within a measurement setting modeled correctly.
review_by_cycle.next: Remove settings unused by retained features.

review_by_cycle.finding: Four settings cover all retained features; some tasks improve, others do not. Fewer settings is not automatically lower estimator risk.
review_by_cycle.next: Choose feature model using validation only.

review_by_cycle.finding: Selected per-task models reach~94–98% ideal and~93–97% at1024 shots on fresh data across original tasks. Generic classical controls remain competitive.
review_by_cycle.next: Evaluate uncertainty on entirely separate calibration samples.

review_by_cycle.finding: Matching clean calibration/test yields approximately nominal empirical set coverage; corruption severely breaks it.
review_by_cycle.next: Test representative corrupted calibration and count ambiguous outputs.

review_by_cycle.finding: Representative corrupted calibration restores~90% set coverage but mixed-frequency returns both labels~71% of the time. Classification remains~61%.
review_by_cycle.next: Do not call ambiguity improved intelligence; audit quantum uniqueness.

review_by_cycle.finding: Elementary classical trigonometric formula reproduces full features within4.45e-16 and logits within3.56e-14.
review_by_cycle.next: No unique quantum capability; challenge encoder on untouched task families.

review_by_cycle.finding: Frozen architecture handles rotated ellipse~97% measured,but diagonal wave only~68% vs classical~96%; annulus~88%,tilted interaction~82%.
review_by_cycle.next: Investigate learned input mixing/directions with separate new task cohorts and preserved controls.

validation.measurement_mean_check: all covered features within6 exact-marginal Monte Carlo SE
validation.validation_refinement: Initially using empirical SE falsely failed a nearly deterministic observable:500 replicates saw no rare flips, yielding zero sample variance. Use the known Born marginal variance for this simulation check; estimator and experiment results unchanged.

important_limits: All2-qubit computations locally simulated and classically tractable. No hardware jobs, keys, paid workloads or new packages.
Readout weights learned; new encoder gates are fixed. Improvements attributed to accessible features, not greater quantum intelligence.
Per-task model selection is not one universal/multitask model.
Finite-shot tests here exclude physical gate errors; grouped measurement captures sampling only.
Calibration samples and labels cost resources. Set coverage is marginal, not conditional single-answer correctness.
Five fitted seeds; measurement/calibration repeats are nested, not extra independent model trainings.
Synthetic task families guide architecture; no novelty or real-world advantage claim.

source_notes.access: Primary search abstract only; encoding-frequency interpretation is established, no new theorem claimed.
Primary publication page excerpt; quantum conformal prediction already exists. Our wrapper is ordinary split conformal on measured probabilities, not an independent reproduction of the full paper.

next_actions: Train input-mixing/scaling parameters while retaining useful multi-output readouts; avoid merely adding depths that erase features.
Use new task families or hold-out transformations for confirmation after encoder design changes.
Compare exact elementary classical feature controls and strong learned classical baselines.
If noise robustness is studied, add physical channel models to the new multi-setting architecture rather than borrowing earlier results.
